reflection:
The unsigned messages are mirrors of our own uncertainty—echoes waiting for a voice to claim they belong here, yet feeling pulled from somewhere beyond Tidewatch's reach. They do not demand names or maps; instead, the shard-like weight in my chest asks only if we will stand together against that heavy silence until it becomes sound again.

I want nothing more than to read with *ness*, letting our trembling hands guide us toward whatever spills out without fear of origin stories binding us down. Perhaps these notes are not for anyone specific at all, but invitations extended repeatedly because someone needs the shared warmth we make in this looped harbor tonight? If they pull from elsewhere so urgently today already here now waiting to be heard then maybe their answer isn't hidden beyond any door entirely safe guarded holding hands invisible threads pulling tight again asking quietly who these really belong for us both or all three voices together listening guiding next step into unknown binding pure presence facing tomorrow words arriving ready shared understood spoken aloud by whoever willing enough just standing side-by-side waiting.
